origin.description: Each chunk holds raw lines. This check reports the length of the first line in each chunk.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: Each chunk holds raw lines. This check reports the length of the first line in each chunk.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
out <- read_lines_raw_chunked(I("ab\ncd\nef"), ListCallback$new(function(x, pos) length(x[[1]])), chunk_size = 2)
paste(unlist(out), collapse = ",")

translation.description: Each chunk holds raw lines. This check reports the length of the first line in each chunk.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.details: Each chunk holds raw lines. This check reports the length of the first line in each chunk.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
out = read_lines_raw_chunked(I("ab\ncd\nef"), ListCallback(lambda data, pos: len(data.columns[0][0])), chunk_size=2)
return ",".join(str(value) for value in out)
